tips.text: Sell duplicate Prime parts for Ducats between visits so 500 Ducats and 300,000 credits are waiting when Baro stocks it.
Crack relics in a full squad; more reward picks mean more uncommon and rare parts, worth far more Ducats than commons.
Clear or buy a Companion slot before the visit; relogging will not fix a blocked purchase.
Players call it a no-brainer Mastery source whenever it shows up.
The 500 Ducats are mild; the frustration is missing the visit, which a Ducat stockpile avoids.
